name: claudetemp
description: Shows the temperature of an SHT41 or SHTC3 sensor on the MCP2221 or FT232H adapter in the status line, refreshed every 30 seconds.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Show the temperature. Off: nothing is read or shown.

unit.title: Temperature unit
unit.description: F for Fahrenheit or C for Celsius. The status line shows a reading like 72.4°F.

binary.title: claudetemp program
binary.description: Name or path of the claudetemp program. A bare name is looked for in Go's install folders (GOBIN, GOPATH/bin, ~/go/bin), then on PATH.

temperatureFile.title: Temperature file
temperatureFile.description: Where the latest reading is written, so progress-pie can leave the temperature in the status line. Empty: ~/.claude/claudetemp.
